info.title: Whatnot Seller API
info.description: REST API for Whatnot sellers to manage listings, orders, and products.

get.description: Returns the current status of the Seller API v2.

Retrieve the analytics for one show owned by the authenticated seller. A show without final analytics still returns 200 with null metrics and a `calculation_status` saying why: WILL_NOT_BE_CALCULATED if the show was cancelled, is private or is a rehearsal, NOT_ENDED if it has not ended, PENDING if it ended and the metrics are still being calculated. Requires read:reports.

403.description: Inventory writes are not enabled for this seller.

post.description: Set a product's sale format, the shows it appears in, and whether it is reserved for live, in one call. Omitted fields are left unchanged. A buy-it-now product that is not reserved for live is listed on the seller's profile shop. A draft product is published by the first call that sets the sale format, sets reserve_for_live, or adds it to shows. Publishing needs every variant priced, inventory, a description, an image, a value for each required category attribute and, in markets that require them, a dimension profile with dimensions. Anything missing is returned together in errors. Requires write:merchandising.

403.description: The seller is not approved to manage inventory.

422.description: The merchandising change could not be applied. When a product isn't ready to publish, errors lists each field to fix.

get.description: Get how and where a product is currently being sold: its sale format, whether it is reserved for live, and whether it is assigned to any upcoming or live show. A buy-it-now product that is not reserved for live is listed for sale on the seller's profile shop. List the assigned shows at GET /merchandising/products/{product_id}/shows. Requires read:merchandising.

List the upcoming or live shows the product is assigned to, by scheduled start time, latest first by default; set reverse=false for earliest first. Ended and cancelled shows are not listed. Only the product's 250 most recent show assignments are considered. Requires read:merchandising and read:shows.

Create a product in the seller's catalog. Whatnot creates one variant for every combination of the product's option values, or a single variant when it has no options. post.summary: Add a tracking code to order items
post.description: Ship order items under a tracking code from the seller's own label. The items move onto one shipment with the tracking code, usually a new one, so read each item's shipment afterwards. The items must ship to the same buyer and address, their shipments must not have been dropped off or shipped, and the seller must be able to use their own labels. Requires write:shipments.

post.description: Queue label generation using the shipment's saved settings. HTTP 200 means enqueued, not generated. Preflight errors are returned synchronously. Receive successful labels through the label-created webhook; worker failures are not currently exposed by this API.

transaction_type.description: The product's sale format. When provided, overwrites the format on the product. Auctions are always reserved for live and are sold only in shows; add the product to one with shows, in this call or a later one, or it is not purchasable anywhere.

reserve_for_live.title: Reserve For Live
reserve_for_live.description: Whether the product is held for live shows only. Auctions are always reserved for live, so this is rejected as false when transaction_type is auction in the same request, and ignored for a product that is already an auction. A buy-it-now product is purchasable on the seller's profile shop only when this is not true. When omitted, the product's current choice is kept. A draft buy-it-now product with no choice yet is treated as false when transaction_type is set, which publishes it to the profile shop. Switching to auction records the product as reserved for live, so switching back to buy-it-now keeps it off the profile shop until this is sent as false.

shows.description: The change to which shows the product appears in. Adding a product to a show that is not among the seller's next upcoming shows is applied in the background. Omit to leave the product's shows unchanged.

MerchandiseProductRequest.title: MerchandiseProductRequest
MerchandiseProductRequest.description:
Merchandising changes to apply to a product in a single call.

Every field is optional; an omitted field leaves that facet unchanged. The
changes are applied together: transaction type first, then show membership,
then profile-shop publication.

tags.name: Products
tags.description:
Create and manage products in a seller's catalog.

A product holds what buyers see: title, description, images, category, and the options it comes in, such as Color or Size. Each variant is one purchasable version of the product, such as Red / Small, and that is where its price, image, and inventory are set. A product with no options still has one variant.

Creating a product does not put it on sale. Whatnot creates the variants for you, with no price, image, or inventory, so a new product is sellable only after you complete these steps in order:

1. Create the product with `POST /products`. One variant is created for every combination of its option values.
2. Get its variants with `GET /products/{product_id}/variants` to get their ids.
3. Set each variant's price for the format you will sell it in (`pricing.buy_it_now.price` or `pricing.auction.start_price`) and its image (`media`, at most one) with `PATCH /products/{product_id}/variants`, and its inventory with `POST /inventory/set`.
4. Put the product on sale with `POST /merchandising/products/{product_id}`. Set `transaction_type` to `buy_it_now` or `auction`, and use `shows` to add it to shows. A buy-it-now product is sold on your profile shop unless `reserve_for_live` is true; auctions are always reserved for live. Every variant must be priced for that format and at least one must have inventory.

A product with no options follows the same steps. Its single variant appears in `GET /products/{product_id}/variants`, and that is where you price it, set its image, and set its inventory. Adding options or option values later creates new variants that also start without a price, an image, or inventory. Set their price, image, and inventory the same way.

seller_financial_report.description:
One CSV row per transaction. Field order is the CSV column order.

The CSV header is this TypedDict's own fields, so a column added to the
page query must be added here too (a test enforces it). These are this
module's own names, not all identical to the real table's: the SQL
aliases shipping_fee/tax_on_commission_fee/payment_processing_fee/
tax_on_payment_processing_fee to the names below (see the page query). The
real table (models/products/receipts/migration/docs/
treasury__seller_earnings_and_costs.yml in Whatnot-Inc/dbt) also has no
column for buyer_shipping_paid or sales_tax_collected, so this report does
not carry them; snapshot_at and report_start_date exist on that table but
are not selected here either.

Every field but `date` and `currency` is `None` for a day with no record
